page.overview:
Who is Chig?

Chig is an entity first made mention of in The Revelations of Glaaki, which appears to have been its only reference to date (: "The Inhabitant of the Lake"). It is apparently some form of deity worshipped by the alien yarkdao, whose Priests of Chig undertake devotional rituals lasting three-and-quarter years in length.
